result:
I would make empathy effortless and universal — not just feeling it occasionally, but truly understanding one another’s experiences, fears, and hopes by default.

If people could more readily see the world through each other’s eyes, many of our biggest problems — conflict, inequality, cruelty, neglect — would become harder to ignore and easier to solve. It wouldn’t erase every challenge, but it would change the foundation we use to face them.
